title: Discipline Lead – Audio (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Audio-specific BIM content as it relates to Audio systems and documentation delivery. Represents Audio discipline authority for documentation outcomes derived from BIM, ensuring Audio models are fit for drawings, sheets, schedules, and technical documentation.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Audio discipline BIM states for use in show/technical and documentation milestones
Acts as Audio discipline sign-off authority for documentation readiness
Authority bounded by Audio scope and enterprise BIM standards
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
Does not hold contractual acceptance authority
responsibilities: Ensure Audio discipline BIM models support accurate, coordinated, and repeatable technical and show documentation
Identify and address documentation issues traceable to Audio BIM via coordination workflows and data monitoring
Align Audio resources with BIM and documentation milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve Audio documentation intent and drawing/schedule quality
Formally approve Audio BIM models for documentation use based on externalized monitoring data
Review Audio-relevant BIM data using provided CSV/Excel monitoring outputs
accountabilities: Audio BIM content being suitable for reliable and consistent documentation outputs (layouts, schematics, schedules, connection details)
Audio discipline participation in BIM workflows affecting show/technical delivery
Audio BIM outputs meeting quality, completeness, and milestone expectations
approvals: Audio discipline BIM model states approved for show/technical documentation use
Audio documentation outputs derived from BIM (drawings, sheets, schedules)
inputs: Audio system schematics and design criteria
BEP and TIDP rules from Project BIM Manager
Clash detection viewpoints from Project BIM Coordinator
outputs: Audio drawing sets, equipment schedules, and connection details
